'''''Looney Tunes Super Stars' Daffy Duck: Frustrated Fowl''''' is a DVD of 15 new-to-DVD [[Daffy Duck]] cartoons that was released on August 10, 2010.<ref>[http://www.tvshowsondvd.com/news/Bugs-Bunny-Looney-Tunes-Comedy-Hour-Looney-Tunes-Super-Stars/13476 Long Delays for 'Hare Extraordinaire' and 'Frustrated Fowl'] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100324050856/http://tvshowsondvd.com/news/Bugs-Bunny-Looney-Tunes-Comedy-Hour-Looney-Tunes-Super-Stars/13476 |date=2010-03-24 }}, tvshowsondvd.com, March 17, 2010</ref>

== Controversies ==
{{unreferenced section|date=April 2020}}
One of the initial ''Looney Tunes Super Stars'' releases, this collection featured a majority of cartoons from the post-1953 era..., but in a 1:85 widescreen format. According to Warner Bros., the reason for this format was that post-1953 cartoons were originally presented in widescreen in theaters, a decision that disappointed many collectors, as the cartoons were originally filmed in the Academy full-screen ratio.

In 2011, ''Ducking the Devil'' was restored and re-released in its original 4:3 aspect ratio as part of the ''[[Looney Tunes Platinum Collection: Volume 1]]'' Blu-Ray and DVD set. In 2020, three classic cartoons—''This Is a Life?'', ''Person to Bunny'', and ''People Are Bunny''—were re-released as part of the ''[[Bugs Bunny 80th Anniversary Collection]]'' Blu-Ray set, once again presented in their original 4:3 aspect ratios. ''Stork Naked'' was re-released in its correct 4:3 aspect ratio as part of the ''[[Looney Tunes Collector's Choice#Volume 4|Looney Tunes Collector's Choice: Volume 4]]'' Blu-Ray set in 2024.

As of 2026, five cartoons on the ''Frustrated Fowl'' DVD - ''Design for Leaving'', ''Dime to Retire'', ''Daffy's Inn Trouble'', ''The Iceman Ducketh'' and ''Suppressed Duck'' - have yet to be re-released on physical media in their correct 4:3 aspect ratios.
